config_recovered.title: Config file was damaged and rebuilt
config_recovered.body: The device config file could not be parsed, so defaults were used for this launch. The original was archived as config.corrupt-<time>.toml if you need anything from it. Settings are editable again.

config_values_reset.title: {{count}} setting(s) reset to default
config_values_reset.body: These values are no longer valid in this version and each went back to its default: {{keys}}. Everything else is untouched.

permission_revoked.title: System permission revoked
permission_revoked.body: Related entry points have been degraded. Re-authorize in system settings.

strict_local_blocked.title: Strict local mode blocked a network task
strict_local_blocked.body: This task requires external capability and was blocked by your privacy setting.

prompt_catalog_rejected.title: Server prompt catalog is incomplete; using bundled prompts
prompt_catalog_rejected.body: The server configuration didn't pass validation, so the built-in one is in use. AI features work normally.
prompt_catalog_rejected.diagnostic: Prompt catalog v{{version}} from the server is missing the required template {{key}}, so this device ignored it entirely and uses the bundled prompts. An administrator needs to publish a complete catalog from the console.

prompt_catalog_degraded.title: Server prompt catalog matches an older manifest
prompt_catalog_degraded.body: Some settings use built-in defaults; AI features work normally.
prompt_catalog_degraded.diagnostic: Prompt catalog v{{version}} was published against an older manifest (v{{manifest}}) and is in effect; the {{missing}} template(s) added in this app version use bundled defaults until an administrator republishes.

recording_disk_low.title: Disk space is running low
recording_disk_low.body: Recording continues, but consider finishing soon to keep the audio safe.

recording_disk_critical.title: Disk almost full — recording stopped
recording_disk_critical.body: Recording stopped gracefully; everything captured so far is saved.

recording_save_unavailable.title: Recording is not being saved to disk
recording_save_unavailable.body: Audio file could not be created. Live transcription continues without archiving.

recording_device_lost.title: Microphone disconnected
recording_device_lost.body: The recording was finalized with the audio captured so far.

recording_input_device_fallback.title: Selected microphone unavailable
recording_input_device_fallback.body: Recording continues with the system default input. Check the device setting.

recording_window_dropped.title: Realtime transcription overloaded
recording_window_dropped.body: Some live text was skipped. Audio is fully saved — run a second pass later.

recording_transcribe_waiting.title: Live transcription hasn't started
recording_transcribe_waiting.body: The local realtime session slots are busy, so no captions yet. Recording and audio saving are unaffected — run a second pass later.

recording_retranscribed.title: Transcript refined
recording_retranscribed.body: This recording was re-transcribed with a higher-accuracy model for a more precise result.

recording_mic_silent_input.title: No microphone signal
recording_mic_silent_input.body: Recording continues, but no sound is coming from the microphone.
recording_mic_silent_input.diagnostic: Check System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone for Lunarca, the system input volume, and the selected input device.

recording_source_rate_mismatch.title: System audio timeline is off
recording_source_rate_mismatch.body: The system audio track is being delivered at a different rate than the device declares, so this track's timestamps and duration will not match real time (audio is still being saved). Stop and restart this recording; if it keeps happening, include the recording time in your report.

distill_batch_queued.title: {{count}} added to the queue
distill_batch_queued.body: They run in order; progress is in the processing queue.

identifier_migrated.title: App identifier updated
identifier_migrated.body: This version uses the app’s final identifier. Your notes, settings and models are all still here. System permissions such as microphone, accessibility, screen and system audio are tied to the identifier, so you need to grant them once more.

recording_speaker_playback.title: Playing through speakers
recording_speaker_playback.body: System audio is playing through the built-in speakers, so the microphone will pick up the other side. Wear headphones for the best track separation and recognition.

transcribe_fetched.title: Link transcription finished
transcribe_fetched.body: The media downloaded from your link has been transcribed and is ready to proofread.

recording_diarized.title: Speaker diarization finished
recording_diarized.body: Speaker labels for this recording are ready — review and rename them in playback.

graph_tags_rescanned.title: Relation tags backfilled
graph_tags_rescanned.body: The vault-wide AI relation tag rescan has finished; graph links are updated.

graph_tags_rescan_halted.title: Relation tag rescan stopped
graph_tags_rescan_halted.body: Several notes failed in a row, so the rescan stopped early. Open the graph and try again.
graph_tags_rescan_halted.body_strict_local: Several notes failed in a row, so the rescan stopped early. Local-only mode is on, so tags are generated on this device — check that the AI engine is running and that the chat model in Model assignment is installed.
graph_tags_rescan_halted.body_on_device: Several notes failed in a row, so the rescan stopped early. Tags are generated on this device — check that the AI engine is running and that the chat model in Model assignment is installed.
graph_tags_rescan_halted.body_official_cloud: Several notes failed in a row, so the rescan stopped early. Tags are generated by Lunarca Cloud — check your connection and account quota, then try again.
graph_tags_rescan_halted.body_organization: Several notes failed in a row, so the rescan stopped early. Tags are generated by your organization server — check the server status or contact your administrator.

fallback.title: Lunarca notification
fallback.body: A status update needs your attention.

history.title: Notification history
history.search_placeholder: Search notification titles, bodies, or categories
history.empty_hint: Finished tasks, permission changes, and system health all land here for you to revisit.

screenshot_permission_missing.title: Screenshot translate needs Screen Recording
screenshot_permission_missing.body: Enable Lunarca under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording, then restart the app.

screenshot_no_text.title: No text recognized
screenshot_no_text.body: The selected area contains no recognizable text. Try capturing a clearer text region.

desktop_lens_region_offscreen.title: Capture range spans displays
desktop_lens_region_offscreen.body: The Translate Space frame straddles two displays, so a single capture cannot reproduce it faithfully. Move the frame back onto one display and try again.

desktop_lens_geometry_not_saved.title: Frame position not saved
desktop_lens_geometry_not_saved.body: The Translate Space frame works for this session, but its position could not be written to disk and will not be remembered after a restart. Check storage permissions and disk space.

llm_default_model_missing.title: Default text model not installed
llm_default_model_missing.body: The default model {{model}} is not installed on this device, so translation/refinement cannot run. Other models are installed — switch the default or re-download.

llm_no_models_installed.title: No local models installed
llm_no_models_installed.body: There is no local text model on this device yet, so translation/refinement cannot run. Download a recommended model first.

recording_system_audio_no_data.title: No system audio captured
recording_system_audio_no_data.body: Allow Lunarca under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, or make sure audio is playing, then start again.

recording_retranscribed_distill.title: Transcript refined
recording_retranscribed_distill.body: The result is more accurate. You can turn this recording into a knowledge note from the playback view.

transcribe_fetched_distill.title: Linked media transcribed
transcribe_fetched_distill.body: The transcript is ready. You can turn it into a knowledge note from the transcript view.

transcribe_imported.title: Imported media transcribed
transcribe_imported.body: The imported audio or video has been transcribed and is ready to proofread.

transcribe_imported_distill.title: Imported media transcribed
transcribe_imported_distill.body: The transcript is ready. You can turn it into a knowledge note from the transcript view.

transcript_translated.title: Transcript translation finished
transcript_translated.body: The translation for this transcript is ready in the playback or transcript view.

chat_ended_distill.title: Chat archived
chat_ended_distill.body: This conversation can be distilled into a knowledge note — from the chat header or the history context menu.

topic_composed.title: Topic page ready
topic_composed.body: A first version of the topic page is ready — click to open. Lunarca will keep filing new points into it.

knowledge_ingested.title: Knowledge base updated
knowledge_ingested.body: This knowledge note's key point was filed into your topic pages — click to see which.

semantic_index_built.title: Semantic index ready
semantic_index_built.body: Rephrased questions and other languages will now find your notes. Click to review the index.

semantic_index_halted.title: Semantic index build stopped
semantic_index_halted.body: Several notes failed in a row, so indexing stopped early. Open settings and try again.
semantic_index_halted.body_strict_local: Several notes failed in a row, so indexing stopped early. Local-only mode is on, so embeddings are generated on this device — check that the AI engine is running and that the bge-m3 embedding model is installed.
semantic_index_halted.body_on_device: Several notes failed in a row, so indexing stopped early. Embeddings are generated on this device — check that the AI engine is running and that the bge-m3 embedding model is installed.
semantic_index_halted.body_official_cloud: Several notes failed in a row, so indexing stopped early. Embeddings are generated by Lunarca Cloud — check your connection and account quota, then try again.
semantic_index_halted.body_organization: Several notes failed in a row, so indexing stopped early. Embeddings are generated by your organization server — check the server status or contact your administrator.

knowledge_checkup_done.title: Deep checkup finished
knowledge_checkup_done.body: Every topic-page claim was checked against its source. Tap to see the report.

knowledge_checkup_halted.title: Deep checkup stopped
knowledge_checkup_halted.body: Several claims in a row could not be judged, so the checkup stopped early. Open the results and try again.
knowledge_checkup_halted.body_strict_local: Several claims in a row could not be judged, so the checkup stopped early. Local-only mode is on, so judging happens on this device — check that the AI engine is running and that the chat model in Model assignment is installed.
knowledge_checkup_halted.body_on_device: Several claims in a row could not be judged, so the checkup stopped early. Judging happens on this device — check that the AI engine is running and that the chat model in Model assignment is installed.
knowledge_checkup_halted.body_official_cloud: Several claims in a row could not be judged, so the checkup stopped early. Judging happens in Lunarca Cloud — check your connection and account quota, then try again.
knowledge_checkup_halted.body_organization: Several claims in a row could not be judged, so the checkup stopped early. Judging happens on your organization server — check the server status or contact your administrator.

knowledge_checkup_due.title: Time for a knowledge checkup
knowledge_checkup_due.body: It has been over two weeks since the last deep checkup. Tap to look — running it is your call.

body.saved: “{{title}}” was saved to your knowledge base.
body.queued: “{{title}}” was saved. Connecting it to your existing knowledge…
body.degraded: “{{title}}” is safely saved; some background maintenance did not finish.
body.failed: “{{title}}” is safely saved, but background maintenance did not complete.

knowledgeReceipt.appliedItems: {{count}} sourced items were written to the page.
knowledgeReceipt.appliedItems_one: {{count}} sourced item was written to the page.
knowledgeReceipt.degraded: Not completed: {{steps}}. The knowledge note is safe and can be retried later.

note_ai_ready.title: AI result ready
note_ai_ready.body: The backgrounded AI action finished — click to open; you decide how it lands.

sync_read_only_started.title: Cloud sync is now read-only
sync_read_only_started.body: Your plan no longer includes cloud sync: you can download but not upload changes. Cloud copies are removed on {{date}}; notes on this Mac are not affected.

sync_read_only_reminder.title: Cloud copies removed in {{days}} days
sync_read_only_reminder.body: Cloud copies are removed on {{date}}; renew to keep them. Notes on this Mac are not affected.

sync_read_only_today.title: Cloud copies are removed today
sync_read_only_today.body: The read-only period ends today and cloud copies will be removed; notes on this Mac are not affected.

sync_vault_deleted_remotely.title: Cloud vault deleted
sync_vault_deleted_remotely.body: The cloud vault “{{name}}” was deleted on another device. This device has stopped syncing it; your local files are all still here.

session_expired.title: Signed out by the server
session_expired.body: The server no longer accepts this device's sign-in credentials (the session expired or the device was revoked). Server-provided chat, translation and transcription will fail until you sign in again; local features are unaffected.

billing_past_due.title: Payment failed
billing_past_due.body: Your payment failed. Update your payment method by {{date}}, or your account will move to the free plan. Service continues and your local data is not affected.

billing_frozen.title: Account is read-only
billing_frozen.body: Your account is read-only because of a payment dispute: cloud inference and sync uploads are paused and your data is not affected. Please contact support.

billing_restored.title: Account back to normal
billing_restored.body: The payment issue is resolved; cloud inference and sync work as usual.

usage_subscription_p80.title: Plan quota 80% used
usage_subscription_p80.body: One item of this period's plan quota is 80% used. See remaining amounts and reset times under Account › Subscription & usage.

usage_subscription_p95.title: Plan quota almost used up
usage_subscription_p95.body: One item of this period's plan quota is 95% used. Once it's used up, server tasks draw on prepaid credits, or are refused before they start if you have none, until the period resets.

usage_subscription_exhausted.title: Plan quota used up
usage_subscription_exhausted.body: One item of this period's plan quota is used up: server tasks now draw on prepaid credits, or are refused before they start if you have none, until the period resets. Upgrade, buy credits, or switch to an on-device model.

usage_prepaid_p80.title: Prepaid credits 80% used
usage_prepaid_p80.body: You've used 80% of the prepaid credits you bought. Prepaid credits never expire; check your balance or buy more on the Account page.

usage_prepaid_p95.title: Prepaid credits almost used up
usage_prepaid_p95.body: You've used 95% of the prepaid credits you bought. Once they're gone, tasks beyond your plan quota are refused before they start.

usage_prepaid_exhausted.title: Prepaid credits used up
usage_prepaid_exhausted.body: Your prepaid credits are used up: tasks beyond your plan quota are refused before they start. Buy more credits or switch to an on-device model.

usage_spend_cap_p80.title: Prepaid spending at 80% of your cap
usage_spend_cap_p80.body: This month's prepaid spending has reached 80% of the cap you set. Once the cap is reached, tasks that need prepaid credits stop; subscription-included quota isn't affected.

usage_spend_cap_p95.title: Prepaid spending close to your cap
usage_spend_cap_p95.body: This month's prepaid spending has reached 95% of the cap you set. Once the cap is reached, tasks that need prepaid credits stop; subscription-included quota isn't affected.

usage_spend_cap_exhausted.title: Monthly prepaid cap reached
usage_spend_cap_exhausted.body: This month's prepaid spending has reached the cap you set: tasks that need prepaid credits won't start, and running ones stop where they are — output so far is kept and billed for what was used. Subscription-included quota isn't affected; adjust the cap on the Account page.

signed_in.title: Signed in
signed_in.body: The browser sign-in is complete. Server capabilities are now available.

trust_rotated.title: The server rotated its signing keys
trust_rotated.body: This server rotated its signing keys. The rotation was endorsed by a signature from the previous keys and verified, so Lunarca switched to the new ones automatically. You need to sign in again; until you do, server-provided chat, translation and transcription will fail. Local features are unaffected.

service_quick_note_saved.title: Saved as a quick note
service_quick_note_saved.body: The selected text is now in your quick notes.

service_quick_note_failed.title: Couldn’t save the quick note
service_quick_note_failed.body: The selected text wasn’t saved. Open Lunarca, make sure a vault is open, and try again.

app_release_ask.title: Check for updates at launch?
app_release_ask.body: Lunarca doesn’t go online to check for updates unless you allow it. Choose under Settings › General › About & updates.

app_release_available.title: A new Lunarca version is available
app_release_available.body: See the release notes and install it under Settings › General › About & updates.

app_release_installed.title: Update installed
app_release_installed.body: The new version starts the next time you open Lunarca.
